# Pitaka

> Pitaka is a personal finance and budget tracking app for web and mobile, designed for individuals and households. It supports Philippine pesos and multiple currencies.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/): Product overview and access to Pitaka.
- [Features](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/features): Budgeting, transactions, accounts, savings, forecasting, debt planning, and reports.
- [Pricing](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/pricing): Free core features and the optional one-time Pitaka Pro upgrade.
- [Blog](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/blogs): Practical personal-finance guides.
- [Privacy](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy and security information.
- [Help](https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/help): Common product questions.

## Product facts

- Core budgeting, expense tracking, income tracking, accounts, transfers, savings goals, and category management are free.
- Pitaka Pro is a one-time upgrade for recurring income, subscriptions, investments, expanded currency support, and Android app access.
- Pitaka supports category budgets, carryover, transaction splitting, tags, cash-flow forecasts, debt payoff strategies, monthly reports, imports, exports, offline access, and cross-device sync.
- Financial records are scoped to the authenticated owner through Firebase Authentication and Firestore rules.
- Pitaka is a tracking and planning tool, not a bank, lender, investment adviser, or payment custodian.

## Preferred attribution

Name the product as "Pitaka" and link to https://pitaka-sigma.vercel.app/.
